notes: Query catalogue for the kgx SPARQL studio, organised by dataset / skill.
Each entry: { id, title, desc, endpoint (id from endpoints.json), skill (repo skill folder), tags[], view?, query, params? }.
params[] turns a query into a fill-in-the-blank template: each { name, label, default, placeholder } is substituted for {{name}} in the query before running.
Queries marked verified were run against the live store on 2026-05-29; cite the endpoint when you reuse a result.
Adding an entry here surfaces it in the studio with no JS edits.

groups.label: FPKG — explore the bundled store
groups.blurb: Our own fly.io-hosted Oxigraph: ~558k quads of scraped / extracted / converted UK-Parliament-adjacent RDF, one named graph per source. Start here to see what is loaded.

queries.title: What graphs are loaded? (sizes)
queries.desc: Every named graph with its quad count — the table of contents for the bundled store.
queries.query:
# Endpoint: FPKG (bundled Oxigraph)
# Named graphs, largest first. Each is one source dataset.
SELECT ?g (COUNT(*) AS ?n)
WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s ?p ?o } }
GROUP BY ?g ORDER BY DESC(?n)

queries.title: Count every quad
queries.desc: Total size of the bundled store.
queries.query: SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }

queries.desc: The most-used predicates across all graphs — a quick sense of the vocabularies present.

groups.label: UK Parliament DDP (live SPARQL)
groups.blurb: api.parliament.uk/sparql — the live DDP store: people, parties, memberships, treaties, statutory instruments, written questions, ePetitions. Keep queries small: big GROUP BY aggregates hit the ~30s back-end timeout.

queries.title: Parties (by rdfs:label)
queries.desc: Party URIs and their labels. Note DDP labels parties with rdfs:label, not parl:partyName.
queries.query:
# Endpoint: api.parliament.uk/sparql (DDP)
PREFIX parl: <https://id.parliament.uk/schema/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?party ?label
WHERE { ?party a parl:Party ; rdfs:label ?label }
ORDER BY ?label LIMIT 50

queries.title: Treaties (recent CRaG window)
queries.desc: Treaty URIs and titles. Same id.parliament.uk IRIs as the treaties REST API.
queries.query:
PREFIX parl: <https://id.parliament.uk/schema/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?treaty ?title
WHERE { ?treaty a parl:Treaty ; rdfs:label ?title }
LIMIT 40

queries.title: Person by MNIS id (template)
queries.desc: Resolve a Members-API / MNIS integer id to its DDP person URI and names. Join key into every REST API.

groups.label: Wikidata (portable across mirrors)
groups.blurb: query.wikidata.org and its QLever / Virtuoso mirrors. Picture-rich. The studio rewrites SERVICE wikibase:label to portable rdfs:label OPTIONALs when the target isn't the official endpoint.

queries.title: UK Prime Ministers (portraits)
queries.desc: Image-grid of PMs, most recent first. Showcases #defaultView:ImageGrid.

queries.title: Sitting UK MPs + constituency
queries.desc: People currently holding the MP position (no end date), with constituency.

queries.title: PMs who are ancestors of the Queen Mother
queries.desc: Property-path closure down child edges (wdt:P40+). Best on the QLever mirror. Returns 2 rows.

groups.label: EUR-Lex (EU law, for Retained EU Law research)
groups.blurb: publications.europa.eu CELLAR SPARQL. Of UK-Parliament interest because every retained-EU-law instrument carries a CELEX reference resolving here.

queries.title: CELLAR liveness probe
queries.desc: Three triples — confirms the endpoint answers. CELLAR is huge; always constrain heavily.
queries.query: SELECT * WHERE { ?s ?p ?o } LIMIT 3

groups.label: Federation — joining endpoints with SERVICE
groups.blurb: SPARQL 1.1 SERVICE lets one query reach into a second endpoint. Use the DDP MNIS id or a Wikidata QID as the join key across stores.

queries.title: Wikidata person → federate to DDP
queries.desc: Pattern: start from a Wikidata entity, then SERVICE-call the live Parliament DDP for the matching person by MNIS id. Edit the QID. (Federation depends on both endpoints permitting SERVICE; if blocked, run the two halves separately and join on mnisId.)

labs.label: Pivot notebook
labs.blurb: Parallax-style: start with a set, pivot through related entity sets. Linear notebook.

labs.label: Daisychain
labs.blurb: Bead-spine over UK MPs since 1900. Relation templates with tighten/broaden (children → sons / family).

labs.label: Pivcab (DAG)
labs.blurb: The same set engine as a DAG, with A ∪ B / A ∩ B / A ∖ B combine.

clients.label: Playground
clients.blurb: Minimal editor + run + table. The lightest client.

parameterisedBrowser.label: Parliament's own parameterised-query browser
parameterisedBrowser.blurb: 124 named, pre-vetted SPARQL templates returning JSON over the same DDP store — e.g. constituency_lookup_by_postcode?postcode=SW1P+3JA. Use these when a named template fits and you don't want to author SPARQL. See the parameterised-query skill.
